description:
Svetlanya is one of my newer characters and she's gotten a lot of development quickly. She's a "water dragon" or "water elf". She is intended to have somewhat of a mermaid like appearance but she still has two legs, not that its visible in this portrait.

The tan variants are just for more natural skintones, but I was aiming for a slightly more unnatural pink tone for her design. That said, I may tweak her design and lean even more into it.
